creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Attention routing's ceiling, and the half that makes the sidebar more than a display. Glanceable states are the floor; an agent that finished or is waiting for somebody is most often on a pane no region shows, so being told about it only helps if going there works.

A focus request naming such a pane now retargets a region onto its tab rather than being refused. The region chosen is one already on that pane's daemon, preferring the focused one so that following a notification does not slide the keyboard's region out from under the next keystroke. A region on another daemon is never taken - a laptop beside a devenv is the arrangement this project exists for, and quietly replacing one with the other is a worse surprise than a region appearing. Only a daemon with no region at all gets a new one.

Cases in corpus/conformance/composition.json; proved end to end in crates/muster-seam/tests/attach.rs, in both directions, because a surface that could only move away from where you were would be a trap.
title: 🧭 Going to a pane no window is showing
